{
  "verdict": "revise",
  "score": 0.45,
  "reasons": [
    "Artifact covers only Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) and does not fulfill the mission goal of researching two competing home battery technologies in parallel.",
    "The artifact is truncated mid-sentence in the Costs section: \"These are pack prices (cells + module, not turnkey system i\" which indicates incomplete content.",
    "Many requested sections are missing or incomplete: 8) typical costs (installed $/kWh and standalone $/kWh) fully, 9) common vendors/models for home use, 10) typical sizing guidance for a 3–6 kW PV household, 11) warranty practices, 12) environmental impacts and recyclability, 13) pros/cons, and 14) a list of primary sources with links and dates.",
    "No secondary technology is presented for parallel comparison (e.g., NMC/NMC-based or solid-state options) as required by the mission.",
    "Structurally, the document lacks a clear, comprehensive Markdown structure and quantitative tables for side-by-side comparisons, including uncertainties and data ranges across metrics."
  ],
  "guidance": "Revise the artifact to (a) introduce a second competing technology alongside LFP (recommended: a commonly used NMC/NMC-based home battery system, or a clearly defined alternative such as solid-state if appropriate for home use); (b) complete all requested sections with structured Markdown headings and subheadings; (c) add quantitative tables for round-trip efficiency, usable capacity/DoD, cycle life, calendar life, and safety; (d) provide complete costs with installed $/kWh and standalone $/kWh ranges from reputable sources; (e) enumerate common vendors/models for home use with current specifications; (f) provide sizing guidance for a 3–6 kW PV household; (g) document warranty practices; (h) address environmental impacts and recyclability; (i) include a vetted list of primary sources with links and dates; (j) explicitly note uncertainties and data ranges wherever applicable; (k) fix the truncation at the end of the Costs section and ensure the document is self-contained and ready for team discussion."
}
